title: Theoretical Foundations of Sequential Dynamic Programming
abstract: arXiv:2610.27449v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many economic problems have several controls per period, whose joint choice is subject to the curse of dimensionality. Solving them in stages is computationally cheaper, but no general result says when staging is exact. I develop a separability theory, discrete choices and non-concave objectives included: staging is exact if utility, transitions, and constraints depend on earlier decisions only through a state passed forward. For each ordering the smallest such state exists and is unique up to relabeling. Any state that keeps staging exact for all preferences over later decisions and the future must carry everything the smallest one carries for the transition. For affine primitives, the smallest state consists of the linear combinations, such as cash-on-hand, on which later outcomes depend. Its dimensions pick the order whose largest stage is smallest. translated_title: 序贯动态规划的理论基础
translated_abstract: 许多经济问题在每一期包含多个控制变量，其联合选择会遭遇维数灾难。分阶段求解在计算上更为廉价，但何时分阶段求解是精确的，目前尚无一般性结论。我发展了一套可分离性理论（涵盖离散选择与非凹目标函数的情形）：当效用、转移和约束仅通过一个向前传递的状态依赖于早期决策时，分阶段求解是精确的。对于每一种决策排序，最小的此类状态存在，且在重新标记的意义上唯一。任何对于后续决策及未来的所有偏好都能保持分阶段求解精确的状态，必须携带最小状态为转移所携带的全部信息。对于仿射型原语，最小状态由后续结果所依赖的线性组合构成，例如手头现金。该状态的维数可用于挑选最大阶段规模最小的求解顺序。在一个包含六个选择的家庭模型中，每个阶段仅在一个三维（状态空间上选择一个变量）……
tldr: 本文建立了序贯动态规划分阶段求解精确性的可分离性理论：当效用、转移与约束仅通过一个向前传递的最小状态依赖于早期决策时，分阶段求解是精确的，且对于仿射型问题，该最小状态由后续结果所依赖的线性组合（如手头现金）构成。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a separability theory establishing that staged dynamic programming is exact if and only if utility, transitions, and constraints depend on earlier decisions only through a minimal forward-passed state, which for affine primitives consists of the linear combinations (such as cash-on-hand) on which later outcomes depend.
